item.title: Milwaukee looks to waive sprinkler retrofit fees for older buildings
item.description: Milwaukee considers waiving permit fees for retrofitting sprinklers in older high-rises to improve safety after recent fatal fires.

item.title: Some states may tax new ‘Trump accounts’ for children
item.description: Trump accounts let parents invest for kids with federal tax benefits, but several states plan to tax earnings, creating potential complications for families.

item.title: Riverfront townhome development proposed in Stevens Point
item.description: Source Commercial Real Estate proposes 63 owner-occupied riverfront townhomes at former Edgewater Manor site in Stevens Point.

item.title: Manufacturers seek tariff certainty amid optimism
item.description: NAM CEO Jay Timmons says manufacturers are optimistic but need tariff certainty as inflation, AI adoption and trade policy shape 2026 growth plans.

item.title: $15.5 billion earmarked for states’ projects
item.description: Congress restores earmarks in the $1.65T 2026 spending bill, directing $15.5B to local projects as debate grows over debt, transparency and politics.

item.title: On the Market: Minneapolis, suburban industrial properties
item.description: Industrial properties in Minneapolis, Maple Grove and Otsego include a 65,000-square-foot warehouse, 157,000-square-foot spec build and 6.4-acre industrial land site.

item.title: Labor Department moves to repeal 2024 independent contractor rule
item.description: Trump administration plans to scrap the 2024 independent contractor rule, easing worker classification for industries like trucking, retail, and gig work.

item.title: Twin Cities housing permits jump; apartments lag
item.description: Twin Cities housing permits rose 138% in February, led by single-family homes, while multifamily construction remained weak despite Hudson growth.

item.title: What’s inside the Kmart site housing proposals?
item.description: Minneapolis seeks public feedback on competing affordable housing proposals from Aeon and Trellis for the first phase of redevelopment at the former Kmart site.

item.title: Interview: Dan Ruehl, senior acquisitions manager, Enclave Cos.
item.description: Dan Ruehl, senior acquisitions manager at Enclave Cos., talks about why Enclave is jumping into the investment game, what the company is looking for in new properties, as well as his own career.
